entities.summary: Florentino "Dong" Galang Lavarias is a Filipino prelate of the Catholic church. He is the fourth and current archbishop of San Fernando. He succeeded Paciano Aniceto as the Archbishop of San Fernando. Prior to his installation, he previously served as fourth bishop of Iba in Zambales from September 1, 2004 to October 27, 2014. He also served as the apostolic administrator of Diocese of Balanga in Bataan from July 22, 2023 to March 1, 2025.
